-- Selected authentic IMDb rows; latest version wins, deterministic ties.
select raw:tconst::string as imdb_tconst,
    nullif(trim(raw:primaryTitle::string),'') as imdb_title,
    try_to_number(raw:startYear::string) as release_year,
    try_to_number(raw:runtimeMinutes::string) * 60 as imdb_duration_seconds,
    nullif(raw:genres::string,'\\N') as genres,
    source_system, _batch_id, _source_file, _loaded_at
from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.imdb_raw
where _batch_id = 'imdb_bea94e86ec6fdac6cc69b038'
qualify row_number() over(partition by raw:tconst::string
    order by _loaded_at desc, _batch_id desc, _source_file desc, to_json(raw) desc)=1

-- Keep ratings at their grain before aggregation; never join ratings to sessions.
with links as (
    select raw:movieId::string as movie_id,
        'tt'||lpad(raw:imdbId::string,7,'0') as imdb_tconst
    from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.movielens_raw
    where _batch_id='movielens_7e24050af79446cb15cf8d00' and raw:record_type::string='link'
    qualify row_number() over(partition by raw:movieId::string order by _loaded_at desc,_source_file desc,to_json(raw) desc)=1
), ratings as (
    select raw:movieId::string as movie_id,raw:userId::string as viewer_id,
        try_to_double(raw:rating::string) as rating,
        to_timestamp_ntz(try_to_number(raw:timestamp::string),0) as rated_at_utc,
        source_system,_batch_id,_source_file,_loaded_at
    from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.movielens_raw
    where _batch_id='movielens_7e24050af79446cb15cf8d00' and raw:record_type::string='rating'
    qualify row_number() over(partition by raw:movieId::string,raw:userId::string
        order by try_to_number(raw:timestamp::string) desc,_loaded_at desc,_source_file desc,to_json(raw) desc)=1
)
select l.imdb_tconst,count(*) as rating_count,avg(r.rating) as avg_rating,
    min(r.rated_at_utc)::date as ratings_start,max(r.rated_at_utc)::date as ratings_end,
    max(r.source_system) as source_system,max(r._batch_id) as _batch_id,
    max(r._source_file) as _source_file,max(r._loaded_at) as _loaded_at
from ratings r join links l on l.movie_id=r.movie_id
group by l.imdb_tconst

-- Fonctions TRY_ et conservation des metadonnees, comme le TD 3.3.
select
    nullif(trim(raw:session_id::string), '') as session_id,
    nullif(trim(raw:content_id::string), '') as content_id,
    nullif(trim(raw:viewer_id::string), '') as viewer_id,
    convert_timezone('UTC', try_to_timestamp_tz(raw:started_at::string))::timestamp_ntz as started_at_utc,
    try_to_number(raw:watched_seconds::string) as watched_seconds,
    lower(trim(raw:device::string)) as device,
    raw,
    source_system,
    _batch_id,
    _source_file,
    _loaded_at
from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.sessions_raw
where source_system = 'sessions_simulated'
  and _batch_id = 'sessions_simulated_6c58e1a654180f3e4b910331'

with checked as (
    select s.*,
        case
            when s.session_id is null then 'missing_session_id'
            when s.viewer_id is null then 'missing_viewer_id'
            when s.started_at_utc is null then 'invalid_started_at'
            when c.content_id is null then 'unknown_content'
            when s.watched_seconds is null or s.watched_seconds <= 0 then 'invalid_watched_seconds'
            when s.watched_seconds > c.duration_seconds then 'watched_seconds_exceeds_duration'
        end as reject_reason
    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.stg_sessions s
    left join SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog c on c.content_id = s.content_id
)
select * from checked
where reject_reason is not null

-- Memes regles de validite que la quarantaine ; device reste soumis aux tests dbt.
select
    s.session_id, s.content_id, s.viewer_id, s.started_at_utc,
    s.watched_seconds, s.device, s.source_system, s._batch_id, s._source_file, s._loaded_at
from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.stg_sessions s
join SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog c on c.content_id = s.content_id
where s.session_id is not null
  and s.viewer_id is not null
  and s.started_at_utc is not null
  and s.watched_seconds > 0
  and s.watched_seconds <= c.duration_seconds
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by s.session_id order by s._loaded_at desc, s._batch_id desc, s._source_file desc,
        s.started_at_utc desc, s.watched_seconds desc, s.device desc, s.content_id desc, s.viewer_id desc
) = 1

-- Flatten the received entity and its IMDb claim; join on verified stable identifiers.
select c.content_id,e.key::string as wikidata_qid,
    e.value:labels:en:value::string as wikidata_label,
    e.value:descriptions:en:value::string as description_en,
    e.value:sitelinks:enwiki:title::string as wikipedia_article,
    w.source_system,w._batch_id,w._source_file,w._loaded_at
from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.wikidata_raw w,
    lateral flatten(w.raw:entities) e,
    lateral flatten(e.value:claims:P345) p,
    SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog c
where w._batch_id='wikidata_b711503480e8aea3d442f00f'
  and p.value:mainsnak:datavalue:value::string=c.imdb_tconst
qualify row_number() over(partition by c.content_id order by w._loaded_at desc,w._source_file desc,e.key desc)=1

with all_values as (

    select
        device as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions
    group by device

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'web','mobile','tv'
)

with totals as (
    select (select count(*) from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.stg_sessions) as raw_rows,
        (select count(*) from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.quarantine_sessions) as rejects,
        (select count(*) from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions) as retained,
        (select count(*)-count(distinct session_id) from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.stg_sessions
            where session_id not in (select session_id from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.quarantine_sessions)) as duplicates
)
select * from totals where raw_rows<>retained+rejects+duplicates or rejects<>1 or duplicates<>1

select s.* from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions s
join SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog c on c.content_id=s.content_id
where s.watched_seconds is null or s.watched_seconds<=0 or s.watched_seconds>c.duration_seconds

),

group by session_id
having count(*) > 1

select content_id
from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikidata
where content_id is null

    content_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikidata
where content_id is not null

-- Jour de debut de session en UTC ; une ligne par jour et contenu.
select
    to_date(started_at_utc) as usage_date,
    content_id,
    count(distinct session_id) as valid_sessions,
    sum(watched_seconds) / 60.0 as minutes_watched
from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions
group by 1, 2

with expected as (
    select to_date(started_at_utc) as usage_date,content_id,
        count(distinct session_id) as sessions,sum(watched_seconds)/60.0 as minutes
    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions group by 1,2
)
select e.*,g.* from expected e full outer join SIDEFLIX.GOLD.gold_content_daily g using(usage_date,content_id)
where e.sessions is null or g.valid_sessions is null or e.sessions<>g.valid_sessions
    or abs(e.minutes-g.minutes_watched)>0.00001

select replace(f.value:article::string,'_',' ') as wikipedia_article,
    try_to_date(substr(f.value:timestamp::string,1,8),'YYYYMMDD') as view_date,
    try_to_number(f.value:views::string) as pageviews,
    w.source_system,w._batch_id,w._source_file,w._loaded_at
from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.wikimedia_raw w,lateral flatten(w.raw:items) f
where w._batch_id='wikimedia_4a60caa5f861b0a04eeb4fa6'
qualify row_number() over(partition by f.value:article::string,f.value:timestamp::string
    order by w._loaded_at desc,w._source_file desc,to_json(f.value) desc)=1

-- Only Sicario is identity-confirmed in source/content_mapping.csv (Netflix title 80046311).
-- Get Out remains in Silver as unmatched; absence/ambiguity is never a zero.
select try_to_date(raw:week::string) as ranking_week,
    raw:category::string as category,raw:show_title::string as show_title,
    raw:season_title::string as season_title,
    try_to_number(raw:weekly_rank::string) as weekly_rank,
    try_to_number(raw:weekly_hours_viewed::string) as weekly_hours_viewed,
    case when raw:show_title::string='Sicario' then 'E' end as content_id,
    iff(raw:show_title::string='Sicario','confirmed','unmatched') as mapping_status,
    source_system,_batch_id,_source_file,_loaded_at
from SIDEFLIX.BRONZE.netflix_raw
where _batch_id='netflix_0286f00f5c7eebccd9debf0a'
qualify row_number() over(partition by raw:week::string,raw:category::string,
    raw:show_title::string,raw:season_title::string
    order by _loaded_at desc,_source_file desc,to_json(raw) desc)=1

with failures as (
    select 'wikimedia_duplicate' as problem from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikimedia group by wikipedia_article,view_date having count(*)<>1
    union all select 'netflix_duplicate' from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_netflix group by ranking_week,category,show_title,season_title having count(*)<>1
    union all select 'bad_rating' from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_movielens where avg_rating is null or avg_rating<0.5 or avg_rating>5 or rating_count<=0
    union all select 'bad_pageviews_or_period' from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikimedia where pageviews is null or pageviews<0 or view_date is null or view_date not between '2026-10-26'::date and '2026-11-01'::date
    union all select 'missing_article_day' from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikimedia group by wikipedia_article having count(distinct view_date)<>7
    union all select 'bad_rank' from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_netflix where weekly_rank is null or weekly_rank not between 1 and 10 or ranking_week is null
    union all select 'imdb_duration_mismatch' from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog where imdb_duration_seconds is null or imdb_duration_seconds<>duration_seconds
)
select * from failures

-- Fixed demonstration snapshots, not an assertion that every real-world day has six films.
-- Referencing sessions makes this upstream check block both Gold publications on failure.
with counts as (
    select 'sessions' as source,count(*) as actual,30 as expected from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions
    union all select 'imdb',count(*),6 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_imdb
    union all select 'catalog',count(*),6 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog
    union all select 'movielens_works',count(*),6 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_movielens
    union all select 'movielens_ratings',coalesce(sum(rating_count),0),74 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_movielens
    union all select 'netflix_rows',count(*),3 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_netflix
    union all select 'netflix_confirmed',count(*),1 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_netflix where mapping_status='confirmed'
    union all select 'wikidata',count(*),6 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikidata
    union all select 'wikimedia_days',count(*),42 from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikimedia
)
select * from counts where actual<>expected

-- Each input is aggregated to one row per content/article BEFORE the joins.
with usage as (
    select content_id,count(distinct session_id) as valid_sessions,sum(watched_seconds)/60.0 as minutes_watched
    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions
    where to_date(started_at_utc) between dateadd(day,-6,to_date('2026-11-01')) and to_date('2026-11-01')
    group by content_id
), netflix as (
    select content_id,count(*) as observed_top10_weeks,min(weekly_rank) as best_observed_rank,
        min(ranking_week) as first_observed_week,max(ranking_week) as last_observed_week
    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_netflix where content_id is not null group by content_id
), pageviews as (
    select wikipedia_article,sum(pageviews) as pageviews,min(view_date) as views_start,max(view_date) as views_end
    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikimedia group by wikipedia_article
)
select to_date('2026-11-01') as analysis_date,c.content_id,c.title,c.imdb_tconst,
    c.release_year,c.genres,c.duration_seconds,u.valid_sessions,u.minutes_watched,
    row_number() over(order by u.minutes_watched desc,u.valid_sessions desc,c.content_id) as editorial_rank,
    m.rating_count,m.avg_rating,m.ratings_start,m.ratings_end,
    n.observed_top10_weeks,n.best_observed_rank,n.first_observed_week,n.last_observed_week,
    iff(n.content_id is null,'not_observed_or_unmatched','confirmed_match') as netflix_status,
    w.wikidata_qid,w.wikidata_label,w.description_en,w.wikipedia_article,
    p.pageviews,p.views_start,p.views_end,
    true as sideflix_sessions_simulated,
    'IMDb; MovieLens; Netflix Top 10; Wikidata; Wikimedia' as external_sources,
    current_timestamp() as published_at_utc
from usage u join SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_catalog c on c.content_id=u.content_id
left join SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_movielens m on m.imdb_tconst=c.imdb_tconst
left join netflix n on n.content_id=c.content_id
left join SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_wikidata w on w.content_id=c.content_id
left join pageviews p on p.wikipedia_article=w.wikipedia_article

with expected as (
    select content_id,count(distinct session_id) as sessions,sum(watched_seconds)/60.0 as minutes
    from SIDEFLIX.SILVER.silver_sessions where to_date(started_at_utc)
      between dateadd(day,-6,to_date('2026-11-01')) and to_date('2026-11-01')
    group by content_id
), actual as (
    select content_id,count(*) as copies,sum(valid_sessions) as sessions,sum(minutes_watched) as minutes
    from SIDEFLIX.GOLD.gold_editorial_weekly group by content_id
)
select e.*,a.* from expected e full outer join actual a using(content_id)
where e.sessions is null or a.sessions is null or a.copies<>1 or e.sessions<>a.sessions or abs(e.minutes-a.minutes)>0.00001
